entities.summary: Betancourt Doctrine, a pivotal event in the history of Venezuela (1958–1976). Part of Punto Fijo Democracy and the Oil Boom. Triggered by Punto Fijo Pact establishes democratic stability. This led to Venezuela co-founds OPEC — September 1960 and Era of 'Saudi Venezuela' — massive oil-fueled spending — 1974.
